mapper.select: select snapshot_id, task_id, platform, city_name, platform_hotel_id, hotel_name, hotel_type, hotel_url, main_image, star_label, comment_score, review_count, min_price, currency, preview_room_name, location_text, crawled_at, raw_json from hotel_collection_snapshot where task_id = #{taskId} order by min_price asc, snapshot_id asc

select room_snapshot_id, snapshot_id, platform_room_id, room_name, bed_info, breakfast_info, cancel_policy, pay_type, room_quantity, original_price, sale_price, total_price, currency, price_description, raw_json from hotel_room_snapshot where snapshot_id = #{snapshotId} order by coalesce(sale_price, total_price, original_price) asc, room_snapshot_id asc
mapper.insert: insert into hotel_collection_snapshot (task_id, platform, city_name, platform_hotel_id, hotel_name, hotel_type, hotel_url, main_image, star_label, comment_score, review_count, min_price, currency, preview_room_name, location_text, crawled_at, raw_json, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time) values (#{taskId}, #{platform}, #{cityName}, #{platformHotelId}, #{hotelName}, #{hotelType}, #{hotelUrl}, #{mainImage}, #{starLabel}, #{commentScore}, #{reviewCount}, #{minPrice}, #{currency}, #{previewRoomName}, #{locationText}, #{crawledAt}, #{rawJson}, #{createBy}, #{createTime}, #{updateBy}, #{updateTime})

insert into hotel_room_snapshot (snapshot_id, platform_room_id, room_name, bed_info, breakfast_info, cancel_policy, pay_type, room_quantity, original_price, sale_price, total_price, currency, price_description, raw_json, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time) values (#{snapshotId}, #{platformRoomId}, #{roomName}, #{bedInfo}, #{breakfastInfo}, #{cancelPolicy}, #{payType}, #{roomQuantity}, #{originalPrice}, #{salePrice}, #{totalPrice}, #{currency}, #{priceDescription}, #{rawJson}, #{createBy}, #{createTime}, #{updateBy}, #{updateTime})
